## Now (September 2026)
- AI Lead at Base10 Partners (venture capital firm, San Francisco), May 2026 – present. Building AI-native tooling for venture investing workflows.
- Exponential-Barrié Fellow, 2026. The Exponential Fellowship (Fundación Barrié) is a high-performance excellence program that selects top STEM graduates and technical professionals in Spain and places them as engineers at top-tier Silicon Valley companies, with visa sponsorship. Evidence: https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7500594634780295168/
- MS in Computer Science at Georgia Institute of Technology, specialization in Artificial Intelligence, 2026 – present (in parallel with the Base10 role).

## Achievements, ordered by merit and difficulty

### 1. Selective programs (national-level selection)
- The Exponential Fellowship (Fundación Barrié), 2026. Selective program for the top Spanish STEM talent; grants employment as an engineer at top-tier Silicon Valley companies.
- Fulbright Master's Scholarship, 2026, awarded and declined by choice. Highly competitive, merit-based funding granted by the Selection Committee on academic excellence, leadership potential and an impactful project (up to $45,000 per year plus insurance and travel).

### 2. Academic distinctions (university-wide, top of cohort)
- Extraordinary Bachelor's Degree Award, University of A Coruña, 2025. The highest possible university-wide distinction of each cohort, for the whole BEng in Computer Science.
- Honour grades (matrícula de honor) in 20 courses of the BEng, including the bachelor's thesis (10).
- Exchange at Hanyang University (Seoul), 2022, with distinction grades in four courses. Funded by a bilateral mobility scholarship in which he was ranked first among all applicants of the university.
- Graduated with honours from both vocational programs at IES San Clemente; second place in the regional extraordinary awards for higher-level vocational education (Galicia, 2021).

### 3. Competitions
- First Prize, InditexTech Track, HackUPC 2025. HackUPC is the largest hackathon in Spain and the largest student hackathon in Europe (700+ participants, 30+ countries). Project: Echolook, an AI-powered virtual fitting room. https://devpost.com/software/echolook
- Bronze medal, WorldSkills Spain 2019 (national), Network Systems Administration, representing Galicia.
- Gold medal, WorldSkills Galicia 2018 (regional), Network Systems Administration, qualifying for the national final.

### 4. Research, thesis and publication
- Best Tool Presentation Award at ECSA 2024 / SPLC 2024 (ACM international conferences), for the tool developed in the bachelor's thesis.
- Best Open Licensed BSc/MSc Thesis in Galicia (Amtega / CIXUG), 2024, for the same thesis (1500 €).
- Best Applied Bachelor's Thesis, second prize, School of Computer Science, University of A Coruña, 2024 (500 €).
- Peer-reviewed publication: "Development of a PLE Factory Environment with GitLab Integration and following ISO/IEC 26580", SPLC '24 (ACM), Luxembourg. https://doi.org/10.1145/3646548.3678013
- Three merit-based research fellowships during the stay at CITIC (2022 – 2024): Open Source Scientific Thesis Grant (CICAS Chair, one of only four students in the university, 2024), Collaboration Scholarship of the Spanish Ministry of Education (national, 2023) and Collaboration Scholarship of the University of A Coruña (2022).
- CiTIUS Summer Research Fellowship, 2023: merit-based one-month research stay at the Singular Research Centre in Intelligent Technologies of the University of Santiago de Compostela. Open call to undergraduates from any university, Spanish or foreign, ranked primarily on academic record; one of 14 fellows selected in the ninth edition.

### 5. Professional
- Full-stack Developer at Invofox (Y Combinator S22), Sep 2024 – Apr 2026, working directly with the founders of an AI startup.
- AI Lead at Base10 Partners (San Francisco), building AI-native tooling for venture investing workflows.

## About (Galicia → California)
Born in Melide, a small town in Galicia, I build today in San Francisco. An engineer shaped by an international academic and professional path, I am drawn to intelligent technologies, computer graphics and entrepreneurship.

## Experience (2018 — Present)
### Base10 Partners — AI Lead — May 2026 – Present
Building AI-native tooling for venture investing workflows.

### Invofox (YC S22) — Full-stack Developer — Sep 2024 – Apr 2026
Contributing to a fast-growing AI startup backed by Y-Combinator, thriving in a dynamic, high-velocity environment while honing entrepreneurial skills through direct collaboration with founders. Collaborating in full-stack development using the MERN stack, delivering scalable solutions aligned with cutting-edge AI applications.

### CITIC — SWE Research Intern (Part-time) — Nov 2022 – Jul 2024
Three merit-based academic fellowships for my stay in the laboratory. Built a Product Line Engineering Development Factory with version control systems integration for product evolution management (via GitLab API). Using technologies such as Quasar, Vue.js, Express.js, MongoDB and Cypress.io.

### Learnovate Centre — Software Development Intern — Jun 2021 – Aug 2021
Developed a Moodle plugin for enhancing its engagement and reducing online learning isolation. Moodle instance deployment and management.

### Teleperformance (TP) — Helpdesk and Data Center Support Intern — Apr 2018 – Jun 2018
Management of computers in an Active Directory. Installation of images through MDT in client computers. Hardware maintenance. Installation and configuration of workstations. Remote Desktop assistance with Dameware and TS. Technical support in Portuguese and English to client companies such as Google, Facebook and Netflix.

## Recognition — Awards (8 entries, 2018 — 2025)

University-wide highest possible distinction of each cohort. This prestigious honor recognizes outstanding academic performance throughout the entirety of the Bachelor's studies in Computer Science and Engineering.

### First Prize Winner — HackUPC · InditexTech Track — 2025
First Prize in the InditexTech Track at HackUPC, the largest hackathon in Spain and the largest student hackathon in Europe, with over 700 participants from 30+ countries. Awarded for Echolook, an AI-powered virtual fitting room that lets users snap a photo, describe what they want, and visualize Inditex garments on themselves in seconds.
Evidence: https://devpost.com/software/echolook

### Best Tool Presentation Award — 18th ACM European Conference on Software Architecture & 28th ACM Systems and Software Product Line Conference — 2024
Awarded at the 18th European Conference on Software Architecture (ECSA) and the 28th Systems and Software Product Line Conference (SPLC) for the best tool presentation. The prize recognized the development and demonstration of a software tool with high practical value, derived from my Bachelor's thesis.
Evidence: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/alejandro-bujan-pampin_splc2024-ecsa2024-award-activity-7240260429455802368-uXr6

Awarded by the Agency for the Technological Modernization of Galicia (Amtega) and CIXUG for the best open-licensed bachelor's or master's thesis in Galicia. The award recognized my bachelor's thesis for its contribution to the open-source ecosystem and its practical relevance (1500 €).

## Recognition — Merit-based Scholarships (8 entries, 2022 — 2026)
### The Exponential Fellowship — Barrié Foundation — 2026
High-performance excellence program for top STEM graduates and technical professionals designed to accelerate the next generation of tech founders in Spain. It grants a full international immersion through employment and advanced mentorship as an Engineer at top-tier companies in Silicon Valley, including visa sponsorship, health insurance, travel expenses, and a competitive annual salary.
Links: https://www.goexponential.org/ · https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7500594634780295168/

### Fulbright Master's Scholarship — Fulbright Commission / U.S. and Spanish Governments — 2026 (declined by choice)
Highly competitive, merit-based funding awarded to top university graduates for the pursuit of Master's degree programs at universities in the United States. Granted by the Selection Committee based on academic excellence, leadership potential, and an impactful project to foster cultural and scientific understanding between both countries (up to $45,000 annually plus health insurance and travel expenses).

### Open Source Scientific Thesis Grant — CICAS Chair, University of A Coruña — 2024
Merit-based funding awarded to only four students across the university for the development of Bachelor's theses in open science and open-source software. Granted by the CICAS Chair to support impactful, open-access scientific work (2000 €).

### Collaboration Scholarship — Ministry of Education and Vocational Training, Government of Spain — 2023
Highly competitive, merit-based national scholarship granted by the Spanish Ministry of Education to support student involvement in university research projects (2000 €).

### CiTIUS Summer Research Fellowship — CiTIUS, University of Santiago de Compostela — 2023
Merit-based fellowship from the Singular Research Centre in Intelligent Technologies of the USC, funded by the Regional Government of Galicia. Open to undergraduates from any university, in Spain or abroad, and ranked primarily on academic record, it selected 14 fellows in its ninth edition for a one-month research stay developing a project in Intelligent Technologies under the supervision of the centre's researchers (750 € plus travel expenses).
Link: https://citius.gal/en/talent/job-offers/expressions-of-interest/citius-summer-fellowships-2023/

### Collaboration Scholarship — University of A Coruña — 2022
Merit-based scholarship awarded by the University of A Coruña to support undergraduate research and academic collaboration within university departments (1680 €).

### Bilateral International Mobility Scholarship — University of A Coruña — 2022
Merit-based grant awarded based on academic excellence for participation in UDC's bilateral international mobility programs. Ranked first among all applicants from the university in the selection process. Used to fund the academic exchange at Hanyang University, South Korea (1000 €).

### International Mobility Grant (Non-EU Countries) — Regional Government of Galicia — 2022
Merit-based mobility grant awarded to students with outstanding academic performance to support study abroad stays in non-EU countries. Used to fund the academic exchange at Hanyang University, South Korea (1700 €).
